title: Arcade drop controls card is the how to play table
why: Critic on the arcade drop (47 and 48, 2 of 5): the controls card was an amber headed table with a two pixel amber box. It is the how to play page on the HUD now: Panel P, light action names, key caps, a teal ring glyph for the extract ring. The prompt on the party pages is light text, the run over footer is 104px, the run over title the muted colour.
now: The controls card at the arcade drop looks like the how to play page.
